/pathways/into-the-green.serp_notes: 'Jungle lodge' outranks 'rainforest lodge' in results; destination-qualified phrases (Costa Rica, Daintree, Amazon) carry the volume. Lead copy with 'jungle and rainforest'.

/pathways/between-tides.serp_notes: 'Private island resort' is the head term; Taha'a/Tahiti and Caribbean qualifiers give the long tail. Results favour 'resort' over 'stay' or 'house'.
sources: Live results pages, 30 Oct 2026; Semrush volumes pending API units

/pathways/above-it-all.serp_notes: 'Mountain lodge' and 'mountain retreat' split the results; 'alpine' skews Europe. Desert plateaus (Atacama) rank under their own name.
sources: Live results pages, 30 Oct 2026; Semrush volumes pending API units

targets: private game reserve lodges South Africa
/pathways/where-the-wild-lives.serp_notes: Most competitive of the eight; owned by operators and 'best safari lodges' listicles. The House's angle is the founder marks and sourced impact notes, and the hand-off to Crux for planning.

/pathways/the-art-of-stillness.serp_notes: 'Wellness retreat' is the head term and means programmes; the collection is broader (stillness, slow days). Copy should say 'wellness and restoration' and not over-promise a programme.
